accessNotes: Pricing widget is client-rendered, so WebFetch's markdown conversion returned NO tier prices; it mis-reported a '$5k = $250' figure on every page, which is actually a Profit Target cell ("$250 | 5%"), NOT a price. Full pricing IS shipped in the initial HTML as an inline JSON payload; retrieved via curl with a desktop User-Agent and parsed directly. All five program pages ship the identical 54-tier payload (verified identical after parsing), so every product's data was cross-confirmed 5x. No geo-block or paywall encountered. ALL PRICES RECORDED ARE LIST PRICES: the payload holds undiscounted values, and promos are applied at checkout as WooCommerce coupons ('applied_coupons', 'discount_percent', 'discount_total' fields present in page JS). ACTIVE PROMOS AT CAPTURE: 'SUMMER SALE: 20% OFF (excl. Instant Lite)' code HOT20, expires 1 September 2026; and 'NEW TRADERS: 30% OFF 2 PHASE PRO' code NEW30, expires 31 December 2026. Neither is blended into priceUsd. INDIA SCREEN: India is absent from the current 35-jurisdiction restricted list repeated on FXIFY support pages. The support pages also publish SumSub ID/address/selfie checks, Rise KYC for withdrawals, a $50 minimum, and a usual 3-business-day processing window; no completed Indian checkout, KYC approval, or payout was independently tested. NOT VERIFIABLE on the firm's domain: overnight-holding policy and copy-trading policy - no such fields exist in the site data, so they are null on every product.
